name: forward-backward posteriors on a trellis
mechanism: run one pass forward and one backward over a state trellis accumulating the probability of reaching each state from each end, then combine them per transition to get the posterior probability of every symbol given the whole received sequence

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'BCJR algorithm' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Error detection and correction: decoding of error correcting codes defined on trellises (principally convolutional codes)
